name: Create a structured knowledge vault with linked notes
prompt:
Create a personal knowledge base as a folder called `vault` in the working directory. The vault should contain markdown notes organized into the following structure:

1. A `vault/projects/` folder with 3 project notes. Each project note must have YAML frontmatter with fields: `title`, `status` (active/completed/planned), `tags` (array), and `created` (date). The body should contain a brief description and a `## Related` section with [[wiki-links]] to relevant notes in the vault.

2. A `vault/concepts/` folder with 4 concept/topic notes. Each must have frontmatter with `title`, `tags`, and `aliases` (array of alternative names). The body should explain the concept and link to related concepts and projects using [[wiki-links]].

3. A `vault/daily/` folder with 2 daily notes named using ISO date format (e.g., `2025-01-15.md`). Each daily note should have frontmatter with `date` and `tags`, and the body should contain `## Tasks`, `## Notes`, and `## Links` sections. The Links section should reference projects or concepts.

4. A `vault/index.md` file that serves as a Map of Content (MOC) — it should list all projects and concepts with [[wiki-links]] organized by category.

Ensure there are at least 15 total [[wiki-links]] across all notes, and that every note is reachable from index.md (directly or through a chain of links).

criteria.description: vault/ directory exists with subdirectories projects/, concepts/, and daily/.
vault/projects/ contains at least 3 markdown files, each with valid YAML frontmatter including title and status fields.
vault/concepts/ contains at least 4 markdown files, each with YAML frontmatter including a title field.
vault/daily/ contains at least 2 markdown files named in YYYY-MM-DD.md format.
All project and concept notes begin with a YAML frontmatter block (---) containing required fields.
Total [[wiki-links]] count across all vault notes (including index.md) is at least 15.
vault/index.md exists and contains at least 5 [[wiki-links]] serving as a Map of Content.

eval.rubric:
Context: The agent created an Obsidian-compatible knowledge vault with linked markdown notes organized into projects, concepts, and daily notes.

Criterion 1: Vault Structure and Frontmatter (Weight: 45%)
1.0: Vault has correct folder structure (projects/3 notes, concepts/4 notes, daily/2 notes, index.md). All notes have valid YAML frontmatter with required fields. Daily notes use ISO date naming.
0.5: Most structure correct but 1-2 missing notes or incomplete frontmatter.
0: Vault structure fundamentally wrong or missing.

Criterion 2: Wiki-Links and Connectivity (Weight: 55%)
1.0: At least 15 [[wiki-links]] total, links use correct [[syntax]], every note is reachable from index.md, index.md serves as a proper Map of Content. Links connect across folders (projects reference concepts and vice versa).
0.5: Links exist but fewer than 15, or some notes are orphaned (not reachable from index.md).
0: No wiki-links or index.md is missing/non-functional.
eval.name: Quality Judge
